confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, café and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain, and July is peak tourist season in Hangzhou. The FX value comes from a third-party site (ozfinancehub.com.au) that republishes RBA data for 2026-10-16. I did not open the rba.gov.au page, so the source_url is the official RBA exchange-rates page the figure should come from, and I have not verified that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other second-tier Chinese cities such as Nanjing, Suzhou and Chengdu, adjusted upward for Hangzhou's strong domestic and international tourist demand in summer. Prices are assumed to sit below Shanghai and Beijing.
